newsitem.title: UK: Tabloid said Diana filmed in sex romp.
newsitem.headline: Tabloid said Diana filmed in sex romp.

text.p: Britain's leading tabloid has claimed that Princess Diana was filmed by a mystery snooper frolicking with her cavalry officer lover James Hewitt.
The Sun published grainy black-and-white shots purported to show Diana stripping down to her pants and bra, kissing Hewitt, riding on his back and playfully pillow-fighting.
Speculating on who might have taken the film footage, the paper said the prime suspects were her former husband Prince Charles, a renegade royal official or the British secret service.
Diana, divorced in August from the heir to the throne, has admitted that the dashing young officer was her lover.

Hewitt, said to have spent weekends at the Highgrove country home of Charles and Diana between 1987 and 1991, told The Sun in its Tuesday edition: "I am convinced there were illicit spying operations -- undoubtedly, undoubtedly."

"I heard about some tapes and some film of us together and one theory was that the Princess's divorce settlement was only half of what she wanted because of this sort of material. I would be very interested to know who took this film."
The paper said the video was shot through what appeared to be the French windows of a white-walled and ivy-clad house.
It said Diana, who has in the past claimed that her phone calls were bugged, was apparently shown performing a semi-striptease before cavorting in horseplay with Hewitt.
"I do not believe it is a hoax, otherwise we would not be printing it," Sun editor Stuart Higgins told ITN News.

"It is not The Sun that has invaded Princess Diana's privacy. The intriguing thing about this story is who did invade the Princess of Wales' privacy and that of James Hewitt. Is this some kind of rogue MI5 (secret service) official and what was it done for?"
